entry.title: A small job on the way
entry.summary: Invite your child to join one useful part of an errand, such as looking at a picture shopping list or helping put an item on the checkout belt.
entry.cue: They may want to be involved in what you are doing, especially during a wait or transition.
detail: Davies includes shopping among ordinary opportunities to contribute. A picture list can let a child look for what comes next with you, and unpacking can continue the shared job at home.
Keep the part manageable and leave time for help. The task need not keep your child occupied for the whole outing; toddlers also need movement and connection while they wait.
